b:
Some doctrines
I held on to tightly
have loosened

The glass fence
broke,
and the magic reflection
was lost

I became
myself

I had thought
my sorrows
were mine alone

Today
my own
thoughts
mock
me

I enjoy
people
I had forgotten to enjoy

Today
my taste
is sweet as well

The arrogance
stuck to me
is losing its place

My
displays of genius
stand as an extension
of foolishness

From them
I am learning
friendship

The maturity
of their
experience
leaves me
amazed too

They
are beautiful

And the experience
with them
is beautiful too
